briefings.title: Muse Wonder: Zuckerberg and Wang's $100B AI

people.name: Alexandr Wang
people.role: Chief AI Officer, Meta Superintelligence Labs

briefings.tldr: Mark Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang announce the launch of Meta's frontier AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, detailing Meta Superintelligence Labs' complete talent reboot and $100B+ CapEx commitment to agentic AI and personal superintelligence.

briefings.title: Creating Muse: The Fastest-Growing AI Product Since ChatGPT | Alexandr Wang, Meta
briefings.tldr: Meta Chief AI Officer and Scale AI co-founder Alexandr Wang details the seven-month creation of Muse—the fastest-growing consumer AI product since ChatGPT—following Mark Zuckerberg’s recruitment of Wang in early 2026 after Meta's Llama 4 setback.

briefings.title: BREAKING NEWS: Trump, Mark Zuckerberg, Dario Amodei, And More Discuss New AI Standards Accords
briefings.tldr: President Trump and top tech leaders announced the formal signing of the "White House Accord on Super Intelligence," officially rebranding AI to SI (super intelligence) and committing to voluntary internal controls, multi-layered audits, and community partnerships to maintain U.S. dominance over China while driving historic economic growth.

briefings.title: LIVE: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta Connect 2026 keynote
briefings.tldr: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and executives unveiled Meta's expanding personal AI and wearables ecosystem at Meta Connect 2026, headlined by the personal AI agent Muse, new Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 styles, audio glasses, FDA-cleared hearing aids, and a breakthrough form factor of VR glasses.

briefings.title: Yann Le Cun : où va l’intelligence artificielle ?
briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun argues that current Large Language Models (LLMs) are a dead end for achieving true human-level machine intelligence, advocating instead for "World Models" (JEPA architecture) that ground learning in physical reality.

briefings.title: Mark Zuckerberg on Muse, Meta's biggest AI bet yet
briefings.tldr: Mark Zuckerberg outlines Meta's AI strategy centered on open distribution, long-term community investments, and its new personal agent, Muse, which operates 24/7 on a secure, confidential virtual machine.

briefings.title: Yann LeCunn: Why AGI is a Dangerous Misnomer
briefings.tldr: Calling large language models "AGI" is a dangerous misnomer because human intelligence is deeply specialized and linguistic capability is remarkably shallow.

briefings.title: Alexandr Wang: From Los Alamos to Superintelligence
briefings.tldr: Alexandr Wang (Scale AI founder, now leading Meta's superintelligence lab) shares his entrepreneurial journey and vision with Garry Tan at Startup School 2026, emphasizing that founders must develop an internal compass and strong conviction to bet on steep exponential trends before they become consensus.

briefings.title: A Script for Mark Zuckerberg | Stratechery by Ben Thompson
briefings.tldr: Meta is pivoting its strategic narrative to embrace its identity as an advertising and entertainment powerhouse, justifying massive AI CapEx by treating compute as a rentable asset that establishes a strict internal "hurdle rate" for ROI.

briefings.title: Mark Zuckerberg on AI's Job Impact, Government Regulation, & How Meta Glasses Changed His Routine
briefings.tldr: During a live interview with Noah Callahan-Bever, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg discussed the launch of Meta's new AI smart glasses designed with EssilorLuxottica, detailing his vision for "personal superintelligence" as a distributed alternative to singular, centralized AI models, while outlining his views on open-source AI, job displacement, and his long-term leadership philosophy.

briefings.title: Biohub: The Future of Biology is Open-Source with Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives
briefings.channel: No Priors: AI, Machine Learning, Tech, & Startups

people.name: Mark Zuckerberg
people.role: Co-founder, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative & CEO, Meta

briefings.tldr: The Chan Zuckerberg Biohub has committed $500 million to its Virtual Biology Initiative, bridging frontier AI with physical wet labs to build open-source "world models" of biology.

briefings.title: Meta AI Chief Wang on Winning the Race in AI
briefings.tldr: At Bloomberg Tech 2026, Meta’s Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang discussed the company's aggressive transition toward frontier AI capabilities, highlighting the success of its "Muse Spark" model and its upcoming competitive "entree" model.

briefings.title: Conversations 2026: AI-Enabled Messaging Innovation for Developers
briefings.tldr: At Meta's fifth annual Conversations conference, Meta announced the global expansion of the Meta Business Agent and the Meta Business Agent Platform, allowing businesses of all sizes to automate end-to-end customer engagement, lead qualification, and transaction processing directly within WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram.

briefings.title: Yann LeCun on What Comes After LLMs
briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun argues that current Large Language Models (LLMs) are a technological dead-end for achieving human-level intelligence; the future lies in "World Models" and the JEPA architecture, which enable AI to plan, reason, and understand the physical world—a vision he is now pursuing through his new startup, AME Labs.

briefings.title: Hab. 225: Jordi Pérez Colomé: Auge y caída de Mark Zuckerberg
briefings.tldr: The narrative surrounding Mark Zuckerberg and Facebook has shifted from visionary utopianism to a "Wall Street with hoodies" reality, where the platform's role in political manipulation and subconscious data mining has turned its creator into a polarizing, hyper-competitive figure under constant regulatory and social scrutiny.

briefings.title: Former Meta chief AI scientist Yann LeCun (Godfather of AI | speaks at India AI Impact Summit |Tech
briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun argues that current AI systems are powerful "information retrieval" tools rather than truly intelligent entities, as they lack the "world models" and real-world reasoning capabilities inherent in biological life.

briefings.title: The LLM Revolution Is Over. The Physical AI Revolution Is Coming Fast
briefings.tldr: Yann LeCun argues the current Large Language Model (LLM) paradigm is reaching its limits, advocating for a "physical AI" revolution based on "world models" that learn from sensory data.
